text:
maya: heads-up: proposing a response-schema reshape for /v2/generate. goal: flatten nested `meta` into `diagnostics` and add an envelope for opt-in clients. thoughts?
sam: envelope seems safe if opt-in. can you outline the opt-in mechanism?
maya: header-based opt-in: `X-Redwood-Compat: v2`. If present we return envelope; otherwise legacy shape for tenants that still expect it.
lin: streaming question: SSE chunks currently assume the old chunk format. wrapping will break naive stream parsers. need a stream-framing flag.
kevin: timeline and rollout plan required. we can't surprise enterprise customers.
tara: telemetry hooks are a must. propose `compat_probe` tag inside envelope and `X-Redwood-Compat-Probe: 1` header for SDK probes.
maya: snippet: ```http
POST /v2/generate HTTP/1.1
X-Redwood-Compat: v2
X-Redwood-Compat-Probe: 1
```
sam: what if old SDKs ignore headers? server should detect client behavior and keep returning legacy shape per-tenant for a tombstone window.
lin: implement tenant routing flag: `compat_mode=legacy|envelope|strict`. routing layer decides fast.
kevin: rollout phases: internal alpha -> opt-in beta -> wide beta -> default switch with tombstone. specify durations.
tara: recommend 60d tombstone for big tenants. also auto-rollback based on 5xx spike thresholds.
maya: propose: alpha behind flag (1w), opt-in beta (week 2), broad beta + SDK updates (week 3), default to envelope at week 6 with 30-60d tombstone.
lin: about perf: we must make envelope unwrap zero-copy / shallow. sniff header and fast-path to unpack kernel. I'll benchmark.
sam: add compatibility test matrix: sync JSON, SSE streaming, websocket streaming, embeddings metadata.
kevin: product needs migration docs, CLI `--compat=v2` flag, and admin console toggle.
maya: add tenant toggle in admin console so success managers can flip.
tara: telemetry plan: emit `compat_mode` on traces and a `compat_mismatch` event when shapes differ. hook to alerts.
ops-bot: canary deploy started by maya at 2024-11-02T15:12:00Z :rocket:
lin: quick perf run: envelope sniff adds ~0.03ms p95 on p3 tests. will run longer soak tonight.
sam: I'll build the staging replay harness and test matrix.
kevin: ensure model fallback (quantized variants) still uses envelope when applicable; coordinate with routing.
maya: agree. action items: lin: perf + streaming tests (24h). sam: test matrix + staging runbook (48h). kevin: comms draft + docs (72h). tara: telemetry + rollback thresholds (48h). maya: feature-flag rollout plan + tenant toggle (72h).
sam: I'll post the staging checklist + PR link when ready.
lin: will post extended perf figures later.
kevin: +1 to envelope + opt-in header approach from PM. keep default conservative.
tara: +1 but keep 60d tombstone and clear alerts.
maya: thanks all. creating FF ticket and linking.
ops-bot: task created: FF-1123 "envelope compat for /v2/generate" assigned to maya (ETA 2024-11-10)
file_notes: Slack discussion capturing an RFC follow-up: envelope-based response migration for /v2/generate, opt-in headers, streaming framing, telemetry, rollout windows, tombstone policy, and action items
